reliability_objective.indicator: accepted durable activities settle or remain explicitly actionable

assumptions.version_and_configuration_contract: Network path, DNS, peer and retry configuration fingerprint.
assumptions.dependency_contract: Accepted messages are eventually delivered while the declared fairness window remains valid.
assumptions.fail_closed_behavior: Keep durable work actionable; never synthesize delivery or success.

reliability_objective.indicator: stable effect identities have at most one committed receiver outcome

assumptions.version_and_configuration_contract: Remote effect endpoint, protocol revision and idempotency contract fingerprint.
assumptions.dependency_contract: A stable operation identity returns one replayable receiver outcome.
assumptions.fail_closed_behavior: Enter pending or indeterminate; never blindly replay an opaque effect.

reliability_objective.indicator: acknowledged committed facts survive restart and point-in-time restore with referenced immutable objects intact

assumptions.version_and_configuration_contract: Database engine exact version, transaction/isolation settings and schema digest.
assumptions.dependency_contract: Committed transactions, row locks, CAS predicates and durability follow the configured engine contract.
assumptions.fail_closed_behavior: Refuse Verified admission or writes when the engine/configuration cannot be authenticated.

assumptions.version_and_configuration_contract: Provider, model revision and request-policy fingerprint.
assumptions.dependency_contract: No semantic correctness theorem is claimed for model output.
assumptions.fail_closed_behavior: Treat every model output as an untrusted proposal and reapply all authority gates.

reliability_objective.indicator: revoked provider material stops authorizing new attempts

assumptions.version_and_configuration_contract: Provider credential endpoint, revision and revocation-policy fingerprint.
assumptions.dependency_contract: Provider-side revocation eventually prevents new use under the declared window.
assumptions.fail_closed_behavior: Stop new attempts and retain an actionable revocation state when freshness expires.

reliability_objective.indicator: revoked busy MCP processes enter draining and terminate

assumptions.version_and_configuration_contract: ACP/MCP protocol version, process image and termination-policy fingerprint.
assumptions.dependency_contract: Revoked busy children drain and terminate within the declared window.
assumptions.fail_closed_behavior: Keep the generation draining and deny new calls until termination is observed.

reliability_objective.indicator: sandbox capability and isolation probes fail closed

assumptions.version_and_configuration_contract: Linux kernel, container runtime, sandbox image and security-policy fingerprint.
assumptions.dependency_contract: Configured namespaces, mounts, seccomp and capabilities enforce the declared isolation contract.
assumptions.fail_closed_behavior: Refuse sandbox activation and Verified status when an isolation probe or fingerprint fails.

reliability_objective.indicator: lost worker ownership is fenced and replacement makes progress

assumptions.version_and_configuration_contract: Kubernetes distribution/version and effective workload-policy fingerprint.
assumptions.dependency_contract: Replacement, scheduling and volume semantics preserve fenced ownership assumptions.
assumptions.fail_closed_behavior: Fence the lost owner and keep work pending/actionable until replacement is authenticated.

reliability_objective.indicator: runtime mutex and semaphore behavior preserves typed owner and permit boundaries

assumptions.version_and_configuration_contract: Rust standard library, Tokio runtime and operating-system scheduler exact versions and configuration fingerprint.
assumptions.dependency_contract: Owned mutex and semaphore guards remain exclusive, release their capacity on drop, and eventually wake eligible waiters under the configured runtime.
assumptions.fail_closed_behavior: Remove direct concurrency qualification when the configured runtime cannot be authenticated; never infer scheduling progress from the pure permit kernel alone.

reliability_objective.indicator: accepted soak workload drains without loss duplicate or starvation

assumptions.version_and_configuration_contract: Workload profile, capacity envelope and deployment configuration fingerprint.
assumptions.dependency_contract: The declared workload stays within measured latency, drain and stability objectives.
assumptions.fail_closed_behavior: Leave work actionable and remove Verified availability claims when the envelope is exceeded.

runtime_evidence.name: OTLP tracer init failed; continuing without trace export

reliability_objective.indicator: secret-free trace evidence is exported or failure is explicit

assumptions.version_and_configuration_contract: Telemetry backend/version, exporter and retention-policy fingerprint.
assumptions.dependency_contract: Secret-free evidence is exported and retained for the declared window.
assumptions.fail_closed_behavior: Expose evidence loss and remove audit/Verified claims that require unavailable evidence.

reliability_objective.indicator: released worker image preserves host execution contract

assumptions.version_and_configuration_contract: Worker image digest, host binary digest and protocol/capability fingerprint.
assumptions.dependency_contract: The selected worker implements the exact executor contract frozen by the Session.
assumptions.fail_closed_behavior: Reject assignment or profile admission when digests or capabilities do not match.
